assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has documented supraventricular tachycardia
The patient reports recurrent episodes of palpitations
The patient reports brief neurological deficits
Ambulatory cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is ordered
The service is denied under reason code CO-22
The denial is a coordination of benefits denial
The denial is issued by Prairie State Medicaid
The patient is the secondary payer
The patient has the right to appeal this determination
